cards.label: Life care plans
cards.title: What will future care cost?
cards.desc: Costing life care plans and reducing future care needs to present value. The specialty, and the subject of 2024 and 2025 papers on projecting medical care and hospital inflation.

cta.t: Discuss a life care plan matter

cards.label: Personal injury
cards.title: What earning capacity was lost?
cards.desc: Lost earnings, earning capacity, fringe benefits and household services, measured before and after the injury.

cards.label: Wrongful death
cards.title: What did the family lose?
cards.desc: Loss of support, household services and the life expectancy behind every lifetime figure, the subject of a 2024 paper.

cards.label: Household services
cards.title: What is unpaid care worth?
cards.desc: Household services, care and support, including nighttime protection, the subject of a 2019 paper in The Earnings Analyst.

sections.label: Retaining
sections.title: To start a case, <t>begin here.</t>
sections.intro: Checklists for injury and death, the retainer and the terms. For the expert disclosure: the CV, the publications and the prior testimony listing.

rows.d: Separate checklists for personal injury and for death, completed by counsel and returned with a report due date. [Injury checklist](https://bpettingill.com/wp-content/uploads/Injury-Checklist.pdf) · [Death checklist](https://bpettingill.com/wp-content/uploads/Death-Checklist.pdf)
Billing rates, retainer and cancellation terms, with an engagement letter to download. [Billing rates](https://bpettingill.com/new-case/billing-rates/)
Eight pages: education, appointments, organizations and publications. Current PDF dated 7 July 2025. [Open the CV](https://www.bpettingill.com/wp-content/uploads/Bernard.Pettingill.Ph_.D.Vita_.pdf)
Depositions and trials since 2017, with case, number and court. [Prior testimony](/pettingill/testimony)
